"""Tests for the published_events topic router map health check."""

from subject import check_published_events_map_health


def _error(result):
    return getattr(result, "error", None)


def _details(result):
    details = getattr(result, "details", None)
    return details if isinstance(details, dict) else {}


def test_none_map_is_unhealthy():
    result = check_published_events_map_health(None)
    assert getattr(result, "name", None) == "published_events_map"
    assert _error(result)
    assert "published_events_map is empty or not loaded" in _error(result)
    assert not _details(result)


def test_empty_map_is_unhealthy():
    result = check_published_events_map_health({})
    assert getattr(result, "name", None) == "published_events_map"
    assert _error(result)
    assert "published_events_map is empty or not loaded" in _error(result)
    assert not _details(result)


def test_unhealthy_error_has_no_contract_suffix_without_path():
    result = check_published_events_map_health(None)
    assert "(contract:" not in _error(result)


def test_contract_path_appears_in_error_for_empty_map():
    result = check_published_events_map_health({}, "/srv/app/contract.yaml")
    error = _error(result)
    assert error
    assert "published_events_map is empty or not loaded" in error
    assert "/srv/app/contract.yaml" in error


def test_contract_path_appears_in_error_for_none_map():
    result = check_published_events_map_health(None, "contract.yaml")
    error = _error(result)
    assert error
    assert "published_events_map is empty or not loaded" in error
    assert "contract.yaml" in error


def test_populated_map_is_healthy():
    topic_map = {
        "OrderCreated": "orders.events",
        "OrderUpdated": "orders.events",
    }
    result = check_published_events_map_health(topic_map)
    assert getattr(result, "name", None) == "published_events_map"
    assert not _error(result)


def test_healthy_details_report_entry_count():
    topic_map = {
        "OrderCreated": "orders.events",
        "OrderUpdated": "orders.events",
        "OrderCancelled": "orders.events",
    }
    result = check_published_events_map_health(topic_map)
    assert _details(result).get("entry_count") == 3


def test_single_entry_map_is_healthy_with_count_one():
    result = check_published_events_map_health({"OrderCreated": "orders.events"})
    assert not _error(result)
    assert _details(result).get("entry_count") == 1


def test_map_with_falsy_values_is_still_healthy():
    result = check_published_events_map_health({"OrderCreated": ""})
    assert not _error(result)
    assert _details(result).get("entry_count") == 1


def test_contract_path_does_not_make_populated_map_unhealthy():
    result = check_published_events_map_health(
        {"OrderCreated": "orders.events"}, "/srv/app/contract.yaml"
    )
    assert not _error(result)
    assert _details(result).get("entry_count") == 1
